name: Al-Asasyah
verdict: Al-Asasyah is the mark of Basic Electronics Company Ltd, which describes itself as a 100% Saudi company. Nothing found.
note: Al-Asasyah Electronics (GREE's agent in Saudi Arabia) shares the 2026/27 Al-Fateh chest lockup with the GREE brand: the club's partners page lists one partner as 'الأساسية - GREE' linking al-asasyah.com, and the shirt lockup combines the AS/الأساسية oval mark with the GREE wordmark. The GREE brand itself is recorded separately (sponsor 'gree', rated none). Rating note: Basic Electronics Company Ltd is a private Saudi company; its site says it is 100% Saudi but does not name its shareholders. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
